mapper.select: select ifnull(mn.cifd_Group_Funds, 0) + ifnull(mn.cifd_Account, 0) as cumulativeFunds from Claim_Incoming_Funds_Dtl mn left join Claim_Incoming_Funds cif on cif.id = mn.cif_Id where mn.p_Id = #{pId} order by cif.Create_Time desc limit 1

select mn.*, cif.cif_Date as cifDate, cif.cif_Ca as cifCa from Claim_Incoming_Funds_Dtl mn left join Claim_incoming_Funds cif on cif.id = mn.cif_Id
and mn.cifd_Is_Receipt = '1'
and mn.p_Id in
#{pId}
